How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
To enjoy the best performance from your Flower Shop Votive, trim the wick to about 1/4 inch before each lighting to ensure a clean, even burn with minimal soot.
On the first burn, allow the wax pool to melt completely to the edges of the glass vessel. For best results and safety, keep the candle in a draft-free space and avoid burning it for more than 3 to 4 hours at a time.
